prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for everyone — the best choice depends on your location in Dallas, roof type (asphalt, metal, tile), whether you’re filing an insurance claim, your budget, desired warranty, and timing. I can help you find the best match. Before I pull specific recommendations, a few quick questions:

- What’s your ZIP code or neighborhood in Dallas?
- Roof type (asphalt shingles, metal, tile, etc.) or do you need an inspection first?
- Is this an insurance claim (storm damage) or a private replacement?
- Any scheduling constraints or budget range?

How to identify the best roofing company (quick checklist)
1. Local reputation and reviews — check Google, Yelp, Angi, Nextdoor and BBB for recent reviews and complaints.  
2. Years in business and examples of local work — ask for recent Dallas project photos and references.  
3. Insurance and liability — verify contractor carries general liability and workers’ comp; get certificates.  
4. Manufacturer certifications — GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning certs mean better warranties and training.  
5. Written, itemized estimate — labor, materials, permit costs, disposal, warranty, start/end dates.  
6. Warranty details — manufacturer (shingles) vs. workmanship (contractor) and length/transferability.  
7. Permits and inspections — contractor should pull permits and coordinate inspections if required.  
8. Payment schedule — avoid large up-front payments; typical: small deposit, progress payments, final after completion and lien waivers.  
9. Written contract — scope, materials, colors, cleanup, timeline, payment and warranty terms.  
10. Avoid “storm chasers” — be cautious of out-of-town crews soliciting after storms without local references.

Questions to ask any roofer
- Are you licensed/registered to work in Dallas? Can you provide proof of insurance?
- How long have you been roofing in Dallas County?
- Do you have manufacturer certifications (GAF, CertainTeed, etc.)?
- Can I see 3 local references from jobs like mine?
- Who will supervise the job on-site? Will you use subcontractors?
- What is included in the estimate and what’s excluded?
- What warranties do you provide (materials and workmanship)?
- Will you obtain permits and handle inspections?
- How do you handle cleanup and gutter protection?
- What is the projected start/completion date and payment schedule?

If you want, I can:
- Look up the top-rated roofing companies in your Dallas ZIP code and return a short list (top 4–6) with ratings, contact info, and recent review highlights;
- Compare 3 written estimates side-by-side and point out red flags;
- Provide a sample checklist/contract addendum you can give to contractors.

Tell me your ZIP code and any preferences and I’ll research specific local options.
